content: We need to determine number of methyl (CH3) groups in the sample's molecule. We have no description of molecule. We can get NMR spectra to infer. Use proton NMR to see methyl signals (singlet ~0.9 ppm). Could also use carbon NMR for methyl carbons (~10-30 ppm). We need to get spectra. Use proton_nmr_spectra tool (no input needed? It says takes SMILES string, but we have no SMILES. The tool signature: proton_nmr_spectra(_: {}) => any. No parameters. So it likely returns spectra for the sample at hand (the unknown). So we can call it.
